extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians specializing in arithmetic geometry and inter-universal Teichmüller (IUT) theory
extracted.subtask_description: Exposition and technical discussion of properties, constructions, and consequences (e.g., Theorem 3.11 and Corollary 3.12) in the Inter-Universal Teichmüller (IUT) III paper, aimed at specialists who must verify/understand multiradial constructions, log-Kummer correspondences, and log-volume estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: SHE property
rubrics_metrics.description: The tautological construction algorithm given by taking 'the λ-th power of q' may be regarded as simultaneously executable relative to both the arithmetic holomorphic structure that gives rise to 'q' and the arithmetic holomorphic structure that gives rise to 'qλ' (this is the SHE property considered in (iii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Achieves simultaneous executability (SHE) but may sacrifice other properties (e.g., IPL); described as essentially tautological in naive examples. Use when one wants simultaneous execution across two arithmetic holomorphic structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPL property
rubrics_metrics.description: Analogue of the IPL property of (iii) — an identification property between objects (e.g., between 'q' and 'qλ') that one seeks to establish when considering assignments simultaneously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinct-label approaches easily give IPL but at cost to SHE; forced-identification approaches may yield both SHE and IPL formally but produce trivial/uninteresting indeterminacies. One must decide approach depending on whether one needs a genuine identification (IPL) or only simultaneous executability (SHE).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinct-labels approach requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: To consider assignments ∗→q and ∗→qλ simultaneously without inconsistency, introduce distinct labels (e.g., '†' and '‡') for the arithmetic holomorphic structures that give rise to q and qλ respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This tautological labeling gives IPL but has the drawback that it is not a priori clear how to compute the relationship between the distinct arithmetic holomorphic structures; thus it may obstruct establishing SHE-type computational relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forced-identification (label forgetting) approach consequence
rubrics_metrics.description: Arbitrarily identifying distinct arithmetic holomorphic structures (deleting labels) permits applying tautological construction algorithms and achieves SHE, but leads to indeterminacies making objects only well-defined up to powers (e.g., q up to q^{λ n}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produces a 'trivial multiradial representation' {q^{λ n}}_{n∈Z}, which satisfies formal analogues of IPL and SHE but is useless for precise applications (e.g., log-volume estimates) because it allows indeterminacy in the value-group portion while holding unit parts rigid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiradial construction algorithm properties (Theorem 3.11)
rubrics_metrics.description: The multiradial construction algorithm should hold with (i) value-group portions of data held rigid (not subject to indeterminacies) and (ii) unit-group portions subject to specified indeterminacies (Ind1, Ind2, Ind3); the algorithm uses the log-Kummer correspondence and intertwining of additive/multiplicative structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This arrangement (rigid value groups, indeterminate units) is essential for applications such as log-volume estimates (Corollary 3.12). The algorithm must exploit log-Kummer correspondence and the log-Kummer/log-Kummer--Kummer interplay (logarithms, additive quotients) rather than just multiplicative quotients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of log-Kummer correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with global (non-)reified Frobenioids that satisfy a log-Kummer correspondence so that multiplicative quotients by local units correspond to additive quotients on the log side; necessary for compatibility properties in Theorem 3.11(ii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kummer isomorphisms obtained by dividing multiplicative groups by local units fail to give the desired log-Kummer correspondence; one must instead work with Frobenioids 'F_mod' / realified objects specifically constructed to satisfy the log-Kummer compatibility required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of all labels in Fl or |Fl|
rubrics_metrics.description: In performing the various transitions among labels/symmetries/processions, one must work with all of the labels in Fl or |Fl| — one does not have the option of arbitrarily omitting certain labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is necessary to perform the transitions (e.g., Fl → |Fl| → ±-processions → (cid:5)-processions) and to avoid invalid omissions that would break the functorial algorithms cited from IUTchI/II.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish arithmetic-holomorphic labels from index sets
rubrics_metrics.description: Labels in Fl, |Fl|, F_l^{(3)} are arithmetic-holomorphic (depend on local/global arithmetic fundamental groups), whereas index sets of mono-analytic ±-processions are 'naked sets' determined only by cardinality and independent of arithmetic holomorphic structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When constructing multiradial representations, separate the arithmetic dependence (labels) from purely combinatorial index sets; index sets are suitable because their construction is independent of arithmetic holomorphic structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstructibility of localization functors via log-volume effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Localization functors (e.g., the '‡ρ_v') for global realified Frobenioids may be reconstructed by considering the effect of multiplication by elements of the global monoids on the log-volumes of local mono-analytic tensor packets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This reconstructibility justifies omitting splitting monoids at v∈V_good from theorem statements since their effect can be recovered from log-volume behavior; routine details are left to the reader in the text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omission of splitting monoids in theorem statements when justified
rubrics_metrics.description: Because of reconstructibility and mutual incompatibilities when working simultaneously with log-shells and splitting monoids at v∈V_good, it can be appropriate to omit explicit mention of splitting monoids from theorem statements (e.g., Theorem 3.11) while keeping them present in the underlying data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omission is acceptable provided the omitted data can be reconstructed and incompatibilities are accounted for as explained in the text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bi-coricity and effective 1-commutativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Bi-coricity of F^{(3)}×μ-prime-strips and mono-analytic log-shells may be interpreted as the statement that various squares in the LGP-Gaussian log-theta-lattice are [1-]commutative with respect to those bi-coric objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this interpretation to treat certain noncommutative diagrams as effectively commutative on the portions constituted by bi-coric objects; this underlies compatibility and construction of LGP-monoids in multiradial representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single Θ_LGP-link requirement to relate unit and value portions
rubrics_metrics.description: To relate both the unit and the value-group portions of the domain and codomain of adjacent vertical-line Θ_LGP-links simultaneously, it is necessary to relate them by means of a single Θ_LGP-link (rather than vertically once-shifted correspondences), due to the noncommutativity of the log-theta-lattice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attempts to relate units and values via separately shifted links run into noncommutativity obstacles; the correct approach uses single links together with the log-Kummer correspondence and the frameworks in §2 and IUTchI definitions referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Framework invariance under pre-composition by log-link iterates
rubrics_metrics.description: To relate Frobenius-like structures to étale-like structures compatibly (so that units can be treated both by Kummer isomorphisms and composites with iterates of the log-link), one needs a framework invariant under pre-composition with iterates of the log-link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This invariance is realized by the log-Kummer correspondences in Theorem 3.11(ii) and is required to accommodate both (a) usual Kummer isomorphisms and (b) their composites with log-link iterates in a way compatible with bi-coricity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insulation of cyclotomes / Kummer theory from Aut_F indeterminacies
rubrics_metrics.description: The log-Kummer correspondences should insulate the cyclotomes and Kummer theory surrounding the étale theta function and κ-coric functions from Aut_{F^{(3)}×μ}(-)-indeterminacies that act on the prime-strips when applying the Θ_LGP-link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This insulation is necessary so that relating unit and value portions across vertical lines does not produce uncontrolled indeterminacies; the log-Kummer correspondence provides this shielding as described in Theorem 3.11(iii).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat data only up to multiplication by roots of unity when forgetting Frobenius-like labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Forgetting labels of Frobenius-like '•'s' (in the log-Kummer correspondence / compatibility) forces identification of certain data up to multiplication by roots of unity; consequently one should consider orbits under roots-of-unity multiplication rather than specific elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This indeterminacy is acceptable in contexts where the theory was formulated invariantly (e.g., theta values or global Frobenioids constructed from sets stabilized by root-of-unity action). Ensure formulations are invariant under these identifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Triviality of cyclotomic rigidity indeterminacies for local data at v∈V_non
rubrics_metrics.description: In the case of local data at v∈V_non appearing in Theorem 3.11(ii)(a), cyclotomic rigidity isomorphism indeterminacies are trivial; no 'vicious circles'/loops arise because there is never confusion between geometric and arithmetic cyclotomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This triviality justifies treating the local Kummer/cyclotomic constructions as natural isomorphisms in the local setting; check references to AbsTopIII for formal grounding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness of possible indeterminacies for Kummer isomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Kummer isomorphisms are completely determined by (a) isomorphisms between the respective cyclotomes and (b) the Galois action on roots of elements of the monoid under consideration, so there are no further possible indeterminacies beyond these.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When constructing or checking Kummer isomorphisms, ensure these two pieces of data are specified; then compatibility with Galois/arithmetic fundamental group actions is tautological.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiradiality and radial/coric decoupling effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The multiradiality and radial/coric decoupling assertions imply that indeterminacies (Ind1), (Ind2) acting on certain data have no effect on the geometric containers (mono-analytic containers) underlying theta/number-field-related data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this decoupling to argue that some indeterminacies do not influence the geometric/holomorphic containers used in the multiradial construction; this is central to ensuring the constructions lead to meaningful geometric outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions for log-volume estimate (Corollary 3.12)
rubrics_metrics.description: For Θ-pilot and q-pilot objects in the multiradial representation of Theorem 3.11, assuming the procession-normalized mono-analytic log-volumes −|log(Θ)| and −|log(q)| lie in ℝ and that |log(q)|>0 (computable from q-parameters at v∈V_bad), one gets −|log(Θ)| ≥ −|log(q)| (i.e., C_Θ ≥ −1 for any C_Θ with −|log(Θ)| ≤ C_Θ·|log(q)|).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proof depends on compactness of relevant holomorphic hulls U_{j,v_Q}, restriction to images interpretable as prime-strips, and the multiradial/log-Kummer framework; check the steps (i)-(v) in the corollary's proof which involve focusing on a single Θ_LGP-link and applying bi-coricity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of bi-coricity of units to compute Θ-pilot objects
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the 0-column Θ-pilot object in terms of the arithmetic-holomorphic structure of the 1-column by relating units on the 0- and 1-columns via the unit-portion poly-isomorphism of the Θ_LGP-link and then applying the bi-coricity of the units (Theorem 1.5(iii),(iv)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret mono-analytic log-shells as multiradial mono-analytic containers for value group structures; vary the Kummer input index along the 0-column to apply log-Kummer correspondences (Theorem 3.11(ii)(a),(b),(c)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with vertically coric structures to obtain vertical-shift invariance
rubrics_metrics.description: To reconcile vertical-shift requirements (units vertically once-shifted vs. impossibility of vertical shift) work on a column with structures invariant under vertical shifts — namely vertically coric structures indexed by '(n,◦)' — related to non-vertically-coric Frobenius-like structures via log-Kummer correspondences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This 'solution' permits treating vertically shifted units consistently but comes at the cost of admitting an indeterminacy constituted by upper semi-compatibility of (Ind3); ensure that the semi-compatibility is acceptable in context.
